CustomField.description: Large account (10+ active subscriptions, Svc_CampaignSource.LARGE_FROM_SUBSCRIPTIONS): phone only, worked from the member page by the large-account person, never in the mail cycle. Set by the Source job when it places the member in the Large account campaign; moves along with the member, so Not now and Closed Lost lead back to Large account instead of Source, and the release skips it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Phone only: this member is called from the member page and never gets the campaign mails.
CustomField.label: Large Account
